name: find_things
summary: Find anything by name or filter: portable tanks, crates, structures, devices, items, players, animals. Filters for prefab, kind, class, labels, broken state, atmosphere, maker, location and area (a box, or near a point). 8 per page, nearest first or by reference id. Read only.

help.text: name_contains matches the shown name (the Labeller name when there is one) and the game's own name under a label, so 'T1' and 'Portable Liquid Tank' both find a tank labelled T1. An area keeps only things standing in it, a box (min and max) or a sphere (near with radius_m, not with a box); a thing in a slot stands where its outermost holder is. prefab keeps one prefab exactly, prefab_contains every prefab name holding the text: on a big base use both prefab and an area, as 'Frame' alone matches thousands of things. find_items is the tool for item quantities and machine stock.
help.keys: things [{made, reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, custom_name, game_name, kind, runtime_type, ...}], count, total, offset, limit, has_more, scanned, local_player {reference_id, display_name, position}.

reply.text: reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, custom_name (the Labeller name), game_name, kind (item; dynamic: a movable thing that is not an item, such as portable tanks, crates, generators, rovers; structure; entity; other), runtime_type, labelable, location (as find_items has it, built for a structure), carried_by, held_in, position, distance_m, is_device, has_atmosphere, is_broken, condition and made. A rocket's part adds rocket_state (OnLaunchMount, Launching, Landing...): its position moves while it flies. A structure adds rotation {facing, up, euler} in the forms place_structure takes (facing and up null off the grid's axes). A paintable thing adds color {index, name, is_default}, as paint reads it; a structure short of its last build state adds build_state {current, last, complete} (describe_device gives what the next state takes).

broken.text: is_broken is the game's own broken state: at maximum damage, a structure in its broken build state, or a burst pipe (whose damage stays 0). condition is broken, damaged, intact, indestructible or none. The game heals a structure it breaks to 0 damage, so it reads 100 % health: is_broken is the signal, not a health number. remove_structure removes one with allow_broken.

made.text: Every item a fabricator, printer or other machine makes is recorded as it is made (on the host, in memory while the game runs; a stack split off a printed one keeps its record). Each thing reports made {maker_id, maker_prefab, maker_name, game_time_s, quantity, split_from} when the log has it; made_by and made_since filter on it.

examples.text: Every portable tank, gas or liquid, whatever its prefab or label: runtime_type DynamicGasCanister. Everything that holds gas: has_atmosphere true. Every label in the world: labelled_only true. Every wrecked structure: broken true, kind structure.

name_contains.description: Part of the shown or the game's name, any case ('T1', 'Nitrogen', 'Liquid Tank').

prefab.description: The whole prefab name, any case, as place_structure and describe_prefab take it ('StructureFrame' is not 'StructureFrameCorner'); with prefab_contains both must match.

prefab_contains.description: Part of the prefab name, any case ('DynamicGasCanister', 'Locker', 'StructurePipe').

kind.description: Only things of this kind; default any.

labelled_only.description: Only things with a Labeller name. Default false.

runtime_type.description: Only things of this class or one built on it, by exact class name, any case ('DynamicGasCanister', 'Device', 'Pipe').

broken.description: true: only things in the game's broken state; false: only things that are not.

has_atmosphere.description: true: only things atmosphere_contents has something for; false: only things without.

made_by.description: Only items the print log has from this maker: its id, or part of its prefab or shown name ('Autolathe').

made_since.description: Only items made at or after this game time (game_clock game_time_s); negative: within that many seconds back.

min.description: Box corner, [x, y, z] m; with max: only things in the box.

near.description: A point, [x, y, z] m; with radius_m: only things whose outermost holder is within radius_m of it.

near_player_m.description: Only things whose outermost holder is within this many metres of the player.

location.description: ground, player, stored, built (a structure) or world (players, animals); default any.

x-paging.order: order nearest (default): nearest the player first (no position last), then prefab name, then reference id; order reference_id: lowest reference id first
